notes.title: Build Notes – Version 1.0.2.6
notes.content:
🆕 New Features

Light Build Optimization: improved lighting system for better visuals and enhanced performance.

Asset Loading Polishing: faster and more efficient loading times, reducing wait times.

New Brazilian Portuguese Voiceover: revised dialogues, higher audio quality, and the addition of new actors and voices.

PlayStation Store Support: initial integration with new features for the platform.

🔧 Improvements and Fixes

Fixed issues with some damage animations triggered when the player takes hits.

Adjusted textures and shaders, optimizing GPU response and performance.

Various minor refinements and polish for overall stability.

notes.title: Build Notes 1.0.2.5
notes.content:
Build Notes 1.0.2.5

Updates and Improvements:

Fixed interaction system issues.

Fixed door system: bug with infected sometimes passing through doors resolved.

Updated enemy construction system: cleaner and more performant code.

Updated difficulty system: various adjustments and bug fixes.

Fixed achievements that were incomplete or partially implemented.

Updated Lipsync system: now more performant.

Updated dialogue system: support for future languages and optimized code.

Improved some textures: standardized scale in the atlas system for better performance.

Reorganized all audio for improved sound quality.

Minor translation fixes.

Adjusted some cinematics.

Minor visual changes for better post-processing and lighting quality.

notes.title: Update – Version 1.0.2.4
notes.content:
[b]Update – Version 1.0.2.4[/b]

Support for multiple save files: You can now use up to 3 save slots.

New Auto Aim Assist system: Aim assistance added for players using a gamepad, improving gameplay comfort.

Cinematic polish and improvements: Adjustments to focus, lighting, camera angles, and various visual enhancements for a more immersive experience.

Character improvements in cutscenes: Code fixes, performance optimizations, and visual upgrades to character models.

Minor bug fixes to enhance overall stability.

UI Widget adjustments for improved clarity and usability.

New achievements: Added achievements for players who collect all documents.

Additional minor optimizations and polish.


We are always working to improve our game, and your feedback is incredibly important to the community.

Sincerely,
Jardel Antunes
BoxGames Productions

notes.title: Update Build 1.0.2.3
notes.content:
Update Build 1.0.2.3

Replacement of various assets with higher quality versions and enhanced textures.

Fixes and improvements to several UI widgets.

General performance optimizations.

New interface: more modern, intuitive, and responsive.

Enemy system update: code optimization and fixes to improve game performance.

New lighting bake, delivering more realistic and immersive lighting.

Fixes to the music track system, with new songs added to enhance the overall atmosphere.

Improved damage and combat system for Creepy enemies.

Minor improvements to the infected combat system.

Added anisotropic filtering (4x, 8x, and 16x) to enhance visual quality.

Adjustments to the player character mesh to prevent deformation during fast movements, along with the addition of subtle facial expressions during gameplay.

New resource balancing, allowing players to unlock all special weapons within a single playthrough.

Various minor tweaks and general improvements.

Note:
The game is constantly evolving. We are working hard to implement as many community suggestions as possible. In the upcoming patches, we will introduce major structural updates, always taking great care not to compromise player progress or saved games.

Thank you for your understanding and support!
Sincerely,
Jardel Antunes
CEO - BoxGames Productions

notes.title: Build Notes 1.0.2.2
notes.content:
[b]Build Notes 1.0.2.2[/b]
Updates
[b]Sound Enhancements:[/b]
New sounds for reloading, zombie footsteps, and ambient effects for greater immersion.
[b]Improved Particle Effects:[/b]
Enhanced dismemberment and headshot effects with better quality.
[b]Animation Adjustments:[/b]
Minor fixes to player and enemy animations.
Tweaks to cinematics for smoother transitions.
[b]Material Optimization:[/b]
Some materials have been refined to improve visual quality and performance.

Removed some underused features that didn’t enhance the player experience, such as the chocolate bar and water, which restored stamina.
Reworked some environments to make them more visually appealing, adding more blood and horror elements.

Adjusted the interface to ensure gamepad players don’t have to switch to a keyboard in certain situations. We apologize for the oversight!
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Fixed gamepad issues—now the game is fully functional on all controllers (we recommend an Xbox controller).
Fixed invisible wall glitches.
Resolved crashes on PCs with low video memory.
Optimized some outdated logic to improve performance.
We are committed to delivering the best possible quality in our game! Thank you to everyone who provided feedback. Our team is small (just two people), so we can’t always reply to everyone, but we are doing our best to improve the game with every update.

Thank you for your support!

Best regards,
Jardel Antunes
Game Developer & Co-Founder of BoxGames Productions

notes.title: Deadly Contagion Version 1.0.1.8 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.0.1.8 - Patch Notes[/b]

New Features:
* Added Physical Objects: New interactive elements that enhance the realism of the environment.
Added Auto Aim Support: Players using controllers now have auto aim assistance to make combat smoother.
* New Traps: Additional traps have been added to increase challenge and variety.
* New Weapons: Three new weapons are now available for purchase at the workbench, expanding your arsenal.
* Balancing Adjustments:
Weapon Damage Balancing: Adjustments made to better balance the firepower of the weapons.
Enemy Health Balancing: Enemy health has been reviewed to ensure a more consistent difficulty across different types of enemies.
* Fixes and Optimizations:
Water Physics Fix: Corrected the water behavior, which now responds properly to physical interactions.
Music Track Fix (Musitrack): Fixed an issue where certain music tracks continued playing even when the volume was turned down.
Code Cleanup: Optimized the code to improve overall game performance.
*  Minor Bug Fixes: Various small bugs have been addressed, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.
Improvements:
*  Code for Other Platforms: Code has been optimized and prepared for releases on other platforms, including Epic Games Store and Microsoft Store.
*  Added Sound Effects: New sound effects have been added for the recently introduced weapons.
*  Workbench Weapon Adjustments: Improved weapon arrangement on the workbench for easier access and purchasing.
*  Cinematics Polishing: Focus adjustments in the intro cinematic for increased immersion.
*  Visual Widget Improvements: Polished the graphical interfaces and enhanced visual clarity for a more refined user experience.
*  Texture Updates: Replaced some textures with higher quality versions to provide a more visually pleasing experience.

ATT: Jardel Antunes
GameDeveloper and CEO BoxGames Productions

notes.title: Build Notes - Version 1.0.0.7 (February 17, 2024)
notes.content:
[b]Build Notes - Version 1.0.0.7 (February 17, 2024)[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

1º Professional Lighting Bake Correction: Addressed lighting bake issues to ensure professional-quality lighting throughout the game environment.
2º Performance Optimization: Polished performance by resolving asset popping in certain areas, leading to smoother gameplay.
3º Zombie Audio Fix: Fixed an issue where zombies occasionally lost their hearing upon breaking free from grapples.
4º LOD Adjustment: Tweaked Level of Detail (LOD) settings to prevent distortion on certain objects.
5º Menu Correction: Resolved conflicts with the Save Game feature in the settings menu.
6º Workbench Rendering: Fixed rendering issues with water when selected in the menu on the workbench.
7º Language Localization: Corrected dubbing discrepancies in English documents that were mistakenly in Portuguese.
8º Score Screen Fix: Rectified instances where the player's rank was not displayed correctly on the score screen.
9º Material and Vegetation Adjustment: Optimized materials and vegetation for improved visual quality and performance.
10º Game Sequence Adjustment: Addressed various bugs affecting game progression.

[b]Upcoming Features:[/b]
For the upcoming version, we are focused on expanding our audience by adding support for additional languages:

[b]Italian
Simplified and Traditional Chinese
Portuguese (Portugal)
Japanese
Korean[/b]

We are dedicated to making our game more visually stunning and enjoyable.

Best Regards,
Jardel Antunes
Game Developer
BoxGames Productions

notes.title: Biuld note V1.0.0.5
notes.content:
[b]Biuld note V1.0.0.5 [/b]
Bug Fixes:

1º Final Score Screen: We fixed an issue where the text wasn't displaying correctly for players using the Russian language due to font incompatibility.

2º Game Loading Screen: The loading screen text is now correctly visible for players using the Russian language.

3º Location Signs: We corrected an issue with location signs that had missing text for Russian players due to font incompatibility.

4º Game Over Screen: We fixed a bug that caused the loss of gamepad input on the "Game Over" screen.

5º Start Button Functionality: The "Start" button is now fully functional when used with a gamepad.

6º Skip Cutscene Button Functionality: We fixed the "Skip Cutscene" button to ensure it works properly with a gamepad.

7º Credits Screen: We resolved a bug that caused improper cuts on the credits screen.

8º Quicktimer Event Button: Fixed an issue where the sound of the infected grabbing the player disappeared only in Portuguese.

9º More Chest Space: We added 5 extra slots to the chest, providing more space for players' items. The chest now has a total of 30 reserved slots.

10º Assistant AI Enhancements: We made adjustments to the Assistant AI to improve its functionality when used with a gamepad.

We hope these fixes and improvements make your gaming experience even more enjoyable! Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Have fun playing!

Sincerely,
Jardel Antunes / BoxGames Productions
